+}
+
+function parseFormatPolicy(policy: unknown): GuiFormatPolicy {
+  if (typeof policy !== "object" || policy === null || !("kind" in policy)) {
+    throw new Error("Invalid format policy");
+  }
+  const value = policy as Record<string, unknown>;
+  const skipUnavailable = value.skipUnavailable === true;
+  if (value.kind === "prefer-lossless" && !skipUnavailable) return { kind: "prefer-lossless" };
+  if (value.kind === "lossless-only") return { kind: "lossless-only", skipUnavailable };
+  if (value.kind === "specific" && typeof value.format === "string" && /^[A-Za-z0-9.+-]{1,16}$/.test(value.format)) {
+    return { kind: "specific", format: value.format.toUpperCase(), skipUnavailable };
+  }
+  throw new Error("Invalid format policy");
+}
+
+function serializeInspection(cached: CachedInspection): GuiInspection {
+  return {
+    albumTitle: cached.album.title,
+    trackCount: cached.tracks.length,
+    tracks: cached.tracks.map((track) => ({
+      number: track.number,
+      title: track.title,
+      formats: [...new Set(track.audioLinks.map(({ format }) => format))],
+    })),
+  };
+}
+
+function sendProgress(sender: Electron.WebContents, progress: DownloadProgress): void {
+  if (!sender.isDestroyed()) sender.send("album:progress", progress);
+}
+
+function registerIpc(): void {
+  ipcMain.handle("output:default", (event) => {
+    assertWindowSender(event.sender.id);
+    return defaultOutputRoot();
+  });
+
+  ipcMain.handle("output:choose", async (event) => {
+    const window = assertWindowSender(event.sender.id);
+    const result = await dialog.showOpenDialog(window, {
+      title: "Choose download folder",
+      defaultPath: defaultOutputRoot(),
+      properties: ["openDirectory", "createDirectory"],
+    });
+    return result.canceled ? undefined : result.filePaths[0];
+  });
+
+  ipcMain.handle("album:inspect", async (event, input: unknown) => {
+    assertWindowSender(event.sender.id);
+    if (typeof input !== "string" || input.length > 2048) throw new Error("Enter one valid album URL");
+    const sourceAlbum = validateAlbumUrl(input).href;
+    const result = await inspectAlbum(sourceAlbum);
+    const cached = { sourceAlbum, album: result.album, tracks: result.tracks };
+    inspections.set(event.sender.id, cached);
+    return serializeInspection(cached);
+  });
+
+  ipcMain.handle("album:download", async (event, request: unknown) => {
+    const window = assertWindowSender(event.sender.id);
+    if (downloads.has(event.sender.id)) throw new Error("A download is already active");
+    if (typeof request !== "object" || request === null || !("outputRoot" in request)) {
+      throw new Error("Invalid download request");
+    }
+    const payload = request as GuiDownloadRequest;
+    if (typeof payload.outputRoot !== "string" || payload.outputRoot.length > 4096 || payload.outputRoot.includes("\0")) {
+      throw new Error("Invalid output folder");
+    }
+    const cached = inspections.get(event.sender.id);
+    if (!cached) throw new Error("Inspect an album before starting a download");
+    const policy = parseFormatPolicy(payload.policy);
+    const plan = planFormats(cached.tracks, policy);
+    if (plan.blocked) throw new Error("The format preview has unavailable tracks; skip them explicitly or choose another policy");
+
+    const controller = new AbortController();
+    downloads.set(event.sender.id, controller);
+    try {
+      const result = await downloadAlbum({
+        ...cached,
+        outputRoot: resolve(payload.outputRoot),
+        policy,
+        signal: controller.signal,
+        onProgress: (progress) => sendProgress(window.webContents, progress),
+      });
+      return { state: result.state, directory: result.directory };
+    } finally {
+      downloads.delete(event.sender.id);
+    }
+  });
+
+  ipcMain.handle("album:cancel", (event) => {
+    assertWindowSender(event.sender.id);
+    downloads.get(event.sender.id)?.abort();
+  });
+}
+
+async function createWindow(): Promise<void> {
+  mainWindow = new BrowserWindow({
+    width: 1120,
+    height: 780,
+    minWidth: 760,
+    minHeight: 620,
+    backgroundColor: "#101717",
+    title: "Khinsider Downloader",
+    webPreferences: {
+      preload: resolve(__dirname, "preload.cjs"),
+      contextIsolation: true,
+      nodeIntegration: false,
+      sandbox: true,
+    },
+  });
+  mainWindow.webContents.setWindowOpenHandler(() => ({ action: "deny" }));
+  mainWindow.webContents.on("will-navigate", (event, url) => {
+    if (!url.startsWith("file://")) event.preventDefault();
+  });
+  mainWindow.on("closed", () => {
+    inspections.delete(mainWindow?.webContents.id ?? -1);
+    mainWindow = undefined;
+  });
+  await mainWindow.loadFile(resolve(__dirname, "../gui/index.html"));
+}
+
+app.whenReady().then(async () => {
+  app.setName("Khinsider Downloader");
+  registerIpc();
+  await createWindow();
+  app.on("activate", () => {
+    if (BrowserWindow.getAllWindows().length === 0) void createWindow();
+  });
+});
+
+app.on("window-all-closed", () => {
+  for (const controller of downloads.values()) controller.abort();
+  if (process.platform !== "darwin") app.quit();
+});

+const albumInput = document.querySelector<HTMLTextAreaElement>("#album-url")!;

+const skipInput = document.querySelector<HTMLInputElement>("#skip-unavailable")!;
+const inspectButton = document.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>("#inspect-button")!;

+const cancelButton = document.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>("#cancel-button")!;

+
+let inspection: GuiInspection | undefined;
+let busy = false;
+
+function setStatus(label: string, tone: "idle" | "working" | "success" | "error" = "idle"): void {
+  statusText.textContent = label;
+  statusDot.dataset.tone = tone;
+}
+
+function selectedFormat(track: GuiTrack): { format?: string; state: string; fallback: boolean } {
+  const value = formatSelect.value;
+  if (value === "prefer-lossless") {
+    const lossless = ["FLAC", "ALAC", "WAV"].find((format) => track.formats.includes(format));
+    if (lossless) return { format: lossless, state: "Ready", fallback: false };
+    const lossy = track.formats.find((format) => format === "MP3") ?? track.formats[0];
+    return lossy
+      ? { format: lossy, state: "Ready", fallback: true }
+      : { state: "Unavailable", fallback: false };
+  }
+  const requested = value === "lossless-only" ? ["FLAC", "ALAC", "WAV"].find((format) => track.formats.includes(format)) : value.slice("format:".length);
+  if (requested && track.formats.includes(requested)) return { format: requested, state: "Ready", fallback: false };
+  return skipInput.checked
+    ? { state: "Skipped", fallback: false }
+    : { state: "Unavailable", fallback: false };
+}
+
+function renderTracks(): void {
+  if (!inspection) return;
+  const rows = inspection.tracks.map((track) => {
+    const selected = selectedFormat(track);
+    const row = document.createElement("tr");
+    row.innerHTML = `<td class="track-number"></td><td class="track-title"></td><td class="track-formats"></td><td class="track-choice"></td><td class="track-state"></td>`;
+    row.querySelector(".track-number")!.textContent = String(track.number).padStart(2, "0");
+    row.querySelector(".track-title")!.textContent = track.title;
+    row.querySelector(".track-formats")!.textContent = track.formats.join(", ") || "None found";
+    row.querySelector(".track-choice")!.textContent = selected.format ?? "-";
+    const state = row.querySelector<HTMLElement>(".track-state")!;
+    state.textContent = selected.state;
+    state.dataset.state = selected.state.toLowerCase();
+    if (selected.fallback) state.textContent += " · fallback";
+    return row;
+  });
+  tableBody.replaceChildren(...rows);
+  const blocked = inspection.tracks.some((track) => selectedFormat(track).state === "Unavailable");
+  downloadButton.disabled = busy || blocked;
+  trackCount.textContent = `${inspection.trackCount} tracks`;
+  emptyState.hidden = true;
+  trackTable.hidden = false;
+}
+
+function currentPolicy(): GuiFormatPolicy {
+  if (formatSelect.value === "prefer-lossless") return { kind: "prefer-lossless" };
+  if (formatSelect.value === "lossless-only") return { kind: "lossless-only", skipUnavailable: skipInput.checked };
+  return { kind: "specific", format: formatSelect.value.slice("format:".length), skipUnavailable: skipInput.checked };
+}
+
+function updateFormatOptions(): void {
+  if (!inspection) return;
+  const formats = [...new Set(inspection.tracks.flatMap((track) => track.formats))].sort();
+  const previous = formatSelect.value;
+  formatSelect.querySelectorAll("option[data-discovered]").forEach((option) => option.remove());
+  for (const format of formats) {
+    const option = document.createElement("option");
+    option.value = `format:${format}`;
+    option.textContent = `Specific format: ${format}`;
+    option.dataset.discovered = "true";
+    formatSelect.append(option);
+  }
+  if ([...formatSelect.options].some((option) => option.value === previous)) formatSelect.value = previous;
+  renderTracks();
+}
+
+function setBusy(value: boolean): void {
+  busy = value;
+  inspectButton.disabled = value;
+  browseButton.disabled = value;
+  albumInput.disabled = value;
+  outputInput.disabled = value;
+  formatSelect.disabled = value;
+  skipInput.disabled = value;
+  cancelButton.disabled = !value;
+  if (inspection) renderTracks();
+}
+
+inspectButton.addEventListener("click", async () => {
+  errorText.textContent = "";
+  inspection = undefined;
+  downloadButton.disabled = true;
+  tableBody.replaceChildren();
+  trackTable.hidden = true;
+  emptyState.hidden = false;
+  setBusy(true);
+  setStatus("Opening visible Chromium to inspect pages", "working");
+  try {
+    inspection = await window.khinsiderDownloader.inspect(albumInput.value.trim());
+    albumTitle.textContent = inspection.albumTitle;
+    updateFormatOptions();
+    setStatus("Preview ready", "success");
+  } catch (error) {
+    errorText.textContent = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
+    setStatus("Inspection failed", "error");
+  } finally {
+    setBusy(false);
+    if (inspection) renderTracks();
+  }
+});
+
+browseButton.addEventListener("click", async () => {
+  const selected = await window.khinsiderDownloader.chooseOutput();
+  if (selected) outputInput.value = selected;
+});
+
+formatSelect.addEventListener("change", () => {
+  skipInput.disabled = busy || formatSelect.value === "prefer-lossless";
+  renderTracks();
+});
+skipInput.addEventListener("change", renderTracks);
+
+downloadButton.addEventListener("click", async () => {
+  if (!inspection) return;
+  errorText.textContent = "";
+  progress.value = 0;
+  progressText.textContent = "Preparing album";
+  setBusy(true);
+  setStatus("Downloading", "working");
+  try {
+    const result = await window.khinsiderDownloader.download({ policy: currentPolicy(), outputRoot: outputInput.value });
+    progress.value = inspection.trackCount;
+    progress.max = inspection.trackCount;
+    progressText.textContent = `${result.state} · ${result.directory}`;
+    setStatus(result.state === "complete" ? "Download complete" : result.state, result.state === "complete" ? "success" : "error");
+  } catch (error) {
+    errorText.textContent = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
+    setStatus("Download failed", "error");
+  } finally {
+    setBusy(false);
+  }
+});
+
+cancelButton.addEventListener("click", async () => {

+  await window.khinsiderDownloader.cancel();
+  setStatus("Canceling active track…", "working");
+});
+
+window.khinsiderDownloader.onProgress((event: GuiProgress) => {
+  progress.max = event.totalTracks;
+  progress.value = event.completedTracks;
+  progressText.textContent = event.stage === "track-start"

+@import url("https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Mono:wght@400;500&family=Manrope:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap");
+
+:root {
+  color-scheme: dark;
+  --ink: #e8efec;
+  --muted: #91a09b;
+  --dim: #60716b;
+  --line: #2c3a35;
+  --panel: #17211d;
+  --panel-raised: #1d2a25;
+  --ground: #101715;
+  --mint: #b3f06c;
+  --mint-dark: #83bd42;
+  --coral: #f28568;
+  --blue: #80bac5;
+  font-family: "Manrope", "Noto Sans", sans-serif;
+  color: var(--ink);
+  background: var(--ground);
+  font-synthesis: none;
+  text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
+}
+
+* { box-sizing: border-box; }
+body {
+  margin: 0;
+  min-width: 720px;
+  min-height: 100vh;
+  background:
+    linear-gradient(115deg, rgba(111, 148, 126, .07), transparent 44%),
+    radial-gradient(ellipse at 95% 100%, rgba(86, 135, 143, .08), transparent 36%),
+    var(--ground);
+}
+button, input, textarea, select { font: inherit; }
+button { cursor: pointer; }
+button:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: .42; }
+
+.app-shell { min-height: 100vh; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
+.topbar { height: 74px; padding: 0 32px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); background: rgba(18, 26, 23, .82); }
+.brand-lockup { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
+.brand-mark { width: 34px; height: 34px; display: grid; place-items: center; background: var(--mint); color: #152018; font-size: 21px; font-weight: 800; clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 72%, 72% 100%, 0 100%); }
+.brand-name { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 800; }
+.brand-subtitle, .eyebrow, .section-index, .mode-label, .progress-label, .app-footer { font-family: "DM Mono", monospace; letter-spacing: 0; }
+.brand-subtitle { margin-top: 3px; color: var(--dim); font-size: 9px; }
+.mode-label { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; color: #bac8c1; font-size: 11px; }
+.mode-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; background: var(--mint); border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(179, 240, 108, .11); }
+
+.workspace { width: min(1440px, 100%); margin: 0 auto; padding: 28px 32px 24px; flex: 1; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(300px, 370px) minmax(380px, 1fr); gap: 18px; }
+.control-panel, .results-panel { border: 1px solid var(--line); background: linear-gradient(155deg, rgba(33, 47, 40, .68), rgba(19, 28, 24, .92) 65%); }
+.control-panel { padding: 24px; align-self: start; }
+.section-heading { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 10px; margin: 0 0 18px; }
+.section-heading h1, .section-heading h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; }
+.section-index { color: var(--mint); font-size: 10px; }
+label { display: block; color: #c2cdc7; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; margin: 0 0 8px; }
+textarea, input[type="text"], select { width: 100%; border: 1px solid #394941; border-radius: 3px; color: var(--ink); background: #101815; outline: none; }
+textarea { min-height: 88px; resize: vertical; padding: 12px; font-family: "DM Mono", monospace; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.7; }
+input[type="text"], select { min-height: 38px; padding: 0 10px; font-size: 11px; }
+textarea:focus, input[type="text"]:focus, select:focus { border-color: var(--mint-dark); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(179, 240, 108, .1); }
+.microcopy { margin: 7px 0 0; color: var(--dim); font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.5; }
+.destination-heading { margin-top: 25px; }
+.format-heading { margin-top: 25px; }
+.path-control { display: flex; gap: 7px; }
+.path-control input { min-width: 0; font-family: "DM Mono", monospace; font-size: 10px; }
+.icon-button { width: 40px; flex: 0 0 40px; border: 1px solid #46564c; border-radius: 3px; color: var(--mint); background: #202c26; }
+.icon-button svg, .primary-button svg { width: 17px; height: 17px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; vertical-align: middle; }
+.check-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-top: 11px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500; }
+.check-row input { accent-color: var(--mint-dark); }
+.action-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 8px; margin-top: 24px; }
+.primary-button, .secondary-button { min-height: 41px; border-radius: 3px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; }
+.primary-button { display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--mint); color: #182017; background: var(--mint); }
+.primary-button:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #c4fa8b; }
+.secondary-button { border: 1px solid #53635a; color: var(--ink); background: #26332c; }

+import { app, BrowserWindow, dialog, ipcMain } from "electron";
+import { resolve } from "node:path";
+import { downloadAlbum, type DownloadProgress } from "../downloader.js";
+import { planFormats } from "../formats.js";
+import { inspectAlbum, validateAlbumUrl, type AlbumPage, type DiscoveredTrack } from "../khinsider.js";
+import { defaultOutputRoot } from "../output.js";
+import type { GuiDownloadRequest, GuiFormatPolicy, GuiInspection } from "../gui-types.js";
+
+type CachedInspection = {
+  sourceAlbum: string;
+  album: AlbumPage;
+  tracks: DiscoveredTrack[];
+};
+
+let mainWindow: BrowserWindow | undefined;
+const inspections = new Map<number, CachedInspection>();
+const downloads = new Map<number, AbortController>();
+
+function assertWindowSender(senderId: number): BrowserWindow {
+  if (!mainWindow || mainWindow.webContents.id !== senderId) throw new Error("Untrusted IPC sender");
+  return mainWindow;
+}
+
+function parseFormatPolicy(policy: unknown): GuiFormatPolicy {
+  if (typeof policy !== "object" || policy === null || !("kind" in policy)) {
+    throw new Error("Invalid format policy");
+  }
+  const value = policy as Record<string, unknown>;
+  const skipUnavailable = value.skipUnavailable === true;
+  if (value.kind === "prefer-lossless" && !skipUnavailable) return { kind: "prefer-lossless" };
+  if (value.kind === "lossless-only") return { kind: "lossless-only", skipUnavailable };
+  if (value.kind === "specific" && typeof value.format === "string" && /^[A-Za-z0-9.+-]{1,16}$/.test(value.format)) {
+    return { kind: "specific", format: value.format.toUpperCase(), skipUnavailable };
+  }
+  throw new Error("Invalid format policy");
+}
+
+function serializeInspection(cached: CachedInspection): GuiInspection {
+  return {
+    albumTitle: cached.album.title,
+    trackCount: cached.tracks.length,
+    tracks: cached.tracks.map((track) => ({
+      number: track.number,
+      title: track.title,
+      formats: [...new Set(track.audioLinks.map(({ format }) => format))],
+    })),
+  };
+}
+
+function sendProgress(sender: Electron.WebContents, progress: DownloadProgress): void {
+  if (!sender.isDestroyed()) sender.send("album:progress", progress);
+}
+
+function registerIpc(): void {
+  ipcMain.handle("output:default", (event) => {
+    assertWindowSender(event.sender.id);
+    return defaultOutputRoot();
+  });
+
+  ipcMain.handle("output:choose", async (event) => {
+    const window = assertWindowSender(event.sender.id);
+    const result = await dialog.showOpenDialog(window, {
+      title: "Choose download folder",
+      defaultPath: defaultOutputRoot(),
+      properties: ["openDirectory", "createDirectory"],
+    });
+    return result.canceled ? undefined : result.filePaths[0];
+  });
+
+  ipcMain.handle("album:inspect", async (event, input: unknown) => {
+    assertWindowSender(event.sender.id);
+    if (typeof input !== "string" || input.length > 2048) throw new Error("Enter one valid album URL");
+    const sourceAlbum = validateAlbumUrl(input).href;
+    const result = await inspectAlbum(sourceAlbum);
+    const cached = { sourceAlbum, album: result.album, tracks: result.tracks };
+    inspections.set(event.sender.id, cached);
+    return serializeInspection(cached);
+  });
+
+  ipcMain.handle("album:download", async (event, request: unknown) => {
+    const window = assertWindowSender(event.sender.id);
+    if (downloads.has(event.sender.id)) throw new Error("A download is already active");
+    if (typeof request !== "object" || request === null || !("outputRoot" in request)) {
+      throw new Error("Invalid download request");
+    }
+    const payload = request as GuiDownloadRequest;
+    if (typeof payload.outputRoot !== "string" || payload.outputRoot.length > 4096 || payload.outputRoot.includes("\0")) {
+      throw new Error("Invalid output folder");
+    }
+    const cached = inspections.get(event.sender.id);
+    if (!cached) throw new Error("Inspect an album before starting a download");
+    const policy = parseFormatPolicy(payload.policy);
+    const plan = planFormats(cached.tracks, policy);
+    if (plan.blocked) throw new Error("The format preview has unavailable tracks; skip them explicitly or choose another policy");
+
+    const controller = new AbortController();
+    downloads.set(event.sender.id, controller);
+    try {
+      const result = await downloadAlbum({
+        ...cached,
+        outputRoot: resolve(payload.outputRoot),
+        policy,
+        signal: controller.signal,
+        onProgress: (progress) => sendProgress(window.webContents, progress),
+      });
+      return { state: result.state, directory: result.directory };
+    } finally {
+      downloads.delete(event.sender.id);
+    }
+  });
+
+  ipcMain.handle("album:cancel", (event) => {
+    assertWindowSender(event.sender.id);
+    downloads.get(event.sender.id)?.abort();
+  });
+}
+
+async function createWindow(): Promise<void> {
+  mainWindow = new BrowserWindow({
+    width: 1120,
+    height: 780,
+    minWidth: 760,
+    minHeight: 620,
+    backgroundColor: "#101715",
+    title: "Khinsider Downloader",
+    webPreferences: {
+      preload: resolve(__dirname, "preload.cjs"),
+      contextIsolation: true,
+      nodeIntegration: false,
+      sandbox: true,
+    },
+  });
+  mainWindow.webContents.setWindowOpenHandler(() => ({ action: "deny" }));
+  mainWindow.webContents.on("will-navigate", (event, url) => {
+    if (!url.startsWith("file://")) event.preventDefault();
+  });
+  mainWindow.on("closed", () => {
+    inspections.delete(mainWindow?.webContents.id ?? -1);
+    mainWindow = undefined;
+  });
+  await mainWindow.loadFile(resolve(__dirname, "../gui/index.html"));
+}
+
+app.whenReady().then(async () => {
+  app.setName("Khinsider Downloader");
+  registerIpc();
+  await createWindow();
+  app.on("activate", () => {
+    if (BrowserWindow.getAllWindows().length === 0) void createWindow();
+  });
+});
+
+app.on("window-all-closed", () => {
+  for (const controller of downloads.values()) controller.abort();
+  if (process.platform !== "darwin") app.quit();
+});

+const albumInput = document.querySelector<HTMLTextAreaElement>("#album-url")!;

+const albumTitle = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>("#album-title")!;
+const trackCount = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>("#track-count")!;
+const statusText = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>("#status-text")!;
+const statusDot = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>("#status-dot")!;

+const progressText = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>("#progress-text")!;
+const emptyState = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>("#empty-state")!;
+const trackTable = document.querySelector<HTMLTableElement>("#track-table")!;
+const errorText = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>("#error-text")!;
+
+let inspection: GuiInspection | undefined;
+let busy = false;
+
+function setStatus(label: string, tone: "idle" | "working" | "success" | "error" = "idle"): void {
+  statusText.textContent = label;
+  statusDot.dataset.tone = tone;
+}
+
+function selectedFormat(track: GuiTrack): { format?: string; state: string; fallback: boolean } {
+  const value = formatSelect.value;
+  if (value === "prefer-lossless") {
+    const lossless = ["FLAC", "ALAC", "WAV"].find((format) => track.formats.includes(format));
+    if (lossless) return { format: lossless, state: "Ready", fallback: false };
+    const lossy = track.formats.find((format) => format === "MP3") ?? track.formats[0];
+    return lossy
+      ? { format: lossy, state: "Ready", fallback: true }
+      : { state: "Unavailable", fallback: false };
+  }
+  const requested = value === "lossless-only" ? ["FLAC", "ALAC", "WAV"].find((format) => track.formats.includes(format)) : value.slice("format:".length);
+  if (requested && track.formats.includes(requested)) return { format: requested, state: "Ready", fallback: false };
+  return skipInput.checked
+    ? { state: "Skipped", fallback: false }
+    : { state: "Unavailable", fallback: false };
+}
+
+function renderTracks(): void {
+  if (!inspection) return;
+  const rows = inspection.tracks.map((track) => {
+    const selected = selectedFormat(track);
+    const row = document.createElement("tr");
+    row.innerHTML = `<td class="track-number"></td><td class="track-title"></td><td class="track-formats"></td><td class="track-choice"></td><td class="track-state"></td>`;
+    row.querySelector(".track-number")!.textContent = String(track.number).padStart(2, "0");
+    row.querySelector(".track-title")!.textContent = track.title;
+    row.querySelector(".track-formats")!.textContent = track.formats.join(", ") || "None found";
+    row.querySelector(".track-choice")!.textContent = selected.format ?? "-";
+    const state = row.querySelector<HTMLElement>(".track-state")!;
+    state.textContent = selected.state;

+    if (selected.fallback) state.textContent += " · fallback";
+    return row;
+  });

+  const blocked = inspection.tracks.some((track) => selectedFormat(track).state === "Unavailable");

+  emptyState.hidden = true;
+  trackTable.hidden = false;
+}
+
+function currentPolicy(): GuiFormatPolicy {
+  if (formatSelect.value === "prefer-lossless") return { kind: "prefer-lossless" };
+  if (formatSelect.value === "lossless-only") return { kind: "lossless-only", skipUnavailable: skipInput.checked };
+  return { kind: "specific", format: formatSelect.value.slice("format:".length), skipUnavailable: skipInput.checked };
+}
+
+function updateFormatOptions(): void {
+  if (!inspection) return;
+  const formats = [...new Set(inspection.tracks.flatMap((track) => track.formats))].sort();
+  const previous = formatSelect.value;
+  formatSelect.querySelectorAll("option[data-discovered]").forEach((option) => option.remove());
+  for (const format of formats) {

+    formatSelect.append(option);

+}
+
+function setBusy(value: boolean): void {

export type GuiFormatPolicy =
  | { kind: "prefer-lossless" }
  | { kind: "lossless-only"; skipUnavailable: boolean }
  | { kind: "specific"; format: string; skipUnavailable: boolean };

export type GuiTrack = {
  number: number;
  title: string;
  formats: string[];
};

export type GuiInspection = {
  albumTitle: string;
  trackCount: number;
  tracks: GuiTrack[];
};

export type GuiProgress = {
  stage: "track-start" | "track-complete" | "track-failed" | "canceled";
  number: number;
  title: string;
  completedTracks: number;
  totalTracks: number;
  bytesReceived?: number;
};

export type GuiDownloadRequest = {
  policy: GuiFormatPolicy;
  outputRoot: string;
};

export type KhinsiderDownloaderApi = {
  defaultOutputRoot: () => Promise<string>;
  chooseOutput: () => Promise<string | undefined>;
  inspect: (albumUrl: string) => Promise<GuiInspection>;
  download: (request: GuiDownloadRequest) => Promise<{ state: string; directory: string }>;
  cancel: () => Promise<void>;
  onProgress: (listener: (progress: GuiProgress) => void) => () => void;
};

declare global {
  interface Window {
    khinsiderDownloader: KhinsiderDownloaderApi;
  }
}

import { contextBridge, ipcRenderer } from "electron";
import type { GuiDownloadRequest, GuiProgress, KhinsiderDownloaderApi } from "../gui-types.js";

const api: KhinsiderDownloaderApi = {
  defaultOutputRoot: () => ipcRenderer.invoke("output:default"),
  chooseOutput: () => ipcRenderer.invoke("output:choose"),
  inspect: (albumUrl: string) => ipcRenderer.invoke("album:inspect", albumUrl),
  download: (request: GuiDownloadRequest) => ipcRenderer.invoke("album:download", request),
  cancel: () => ipcRenderer.invoke("album:cancel"),
  onProgress: (listener: (progress: GuiProgress) => void) => {
    const handler = (_event: Electron.IpcRendererEvent, progress: GuiProgress) => listener(progress);
    ipcRenderer.on("album:progress", handler);
    return () => ipcRenderer.removeListener("album:progress", handler);
  },
};

contextBridge.exposeInMainWorld("khinsiderDownloader", api);

import { app, BrowserWindow, dialog, ipcMain } from "electron";
import { resolve } from "node:path";
import { downloadAlbum, type DownloadProgress } from "../downloader.js";
import { planFormats } from "../formats.js";
import { inspectAlbum, validateAlbumUrl, type AlbumPage, type DiscoveredTrack } from "../khinsider.js";
import { defaultOutputRoot } from "../output.js";
import type { GuiDownloadRequest, GuiFormatPolicy, GuiInspection } from "../gui-types.js";

type CachedInspection = {
  sourceAlbum: string;
  album: AlbumPage;
  tracks: DiscoveredTrack[];
};

let mainWindow: BrowserWindow | undefined;
const inspections = new Map<number, CachedInspection>();
const downloads = new Map<number, AbortController>();

function assertWindowSender(senderId: number): BrowserWindow {
  if (!mainWindow || mainWindow.webContents.id !== senderId) throw new Error("Untrusted IPC sender");
  return mainWindow;
}

function parseFormatPolicy(policy: unknown): GuiFormatPolicy {
  if (typeof policy !== "object" || policy === null || !("kind" in policy)) {
    throw new Error("Invalid format policy");
  }
  const value = policy as Record<string, unknown>;
  const skipUnavailable = value.skipUnavailable === true;
  if (value.kind === "prefer-lossless" && !skipUnavailable) return { kind: "prefer-lossless" };
  if (value.kind === "lossless-only") return { kind: "lossless-only", skipUnavailable };
  if (value.kind === "specific" && typeof value.format === "string" && /^[A-Za-z0-9.+-]{1,16}$/.test(value.format)) {
    return { kind: "specific", format: value.format.toUpperCase(), skipUnavailable };
  }
  throw new Error("Invalid format policy");
}

function serializeInspection(cached: CachedInspection): GuiInspection {
  return {
    albumTitle: cached.album.title,
    trackCount: cached.tracks.length,
    tracks: cached.tracks.map((track) => ({
      number: track.number,
      title: track.title,
      formats: [...new Set(track.audioLinks.map(({ format }) => format))],
    })),
  };
}

function sendProgress(sender: Electron.WebContents, progress: DownloadProgress): void {
  if (!sender.isDestroyed()) sender.send("album:progress", progress);
}

function registerIpc(): void {
  ipcMain.handle("output:default", (event) => {
    assertWindowSender(event.sender.id);
    return defaultOutputRoot();
  });

  ipcMain.handle("output:choose", async (event) => {
    const window = assertWindowSender(event.sender.id);
    const result = await dialog.showOpenDialog(window, {
      title: "Choose download folder",
      defaultPath: defaultOutputRoot(),
      properties: ["openDirectory", "createDirectory"],
    });
    return result.canceled ? undefined : result.filePaths[0];
  });

  ipcMain.handle("album:inspect", async (event, input: unknown) => {
    assertWindowSender(event.sender.id);
    if (typeof input !== "string" || input.length > 2048) throw new Error("Enter one valid album URL");
    const sourceAlbum = validateAlbumUrl(input).href;
    const result = await inspectAlbum(sourceAlbum);
    const cached = { sourceAlbum, album: result.album, tracks: result.tracks };
    inspections.set(event.sender.id, cached);
    return serializeInspection(cached);
  });

  ipcMain.handle("album:download", async (event, request: unknown) => {
    const window = assertWindowSender(event.sender.id);
    if (downloads.has(event.sender.id)) throw new Error("A download is already active");
    if (typeof request !== "object" || request === null || !("outputRoot" in request)) {
      throw new Error("Invalid download request");
    }
    const payload = request as GuiDownloadRequest;
    if (typeof payload.outputRoot !== "string" || payload.outputRoot.length > 4096 || payload.outputRoot.includes("\0")) {
      throw new Error("Invalid output folder");
    }
    const cached = inspections.get(event.sender.id);
    if (!cached) throw new Error("Inspect an album before starting a download");
    const policy = parseFormatPolicy(payload.policy);
    const plan = planFormats(cached.tracks, policy);
    if (plan.blocked) throw new Error("The format preview has unavailable tracks; skip them explicitly or choose another policy");

    const controller = new AbortController();
    downloads.set(event.sender.id, controller);
    try {
      const result = await downloadAlbum({
        ...cached,
        outputRoot: resolve(payload.outputRoot),
        policy,
        signal: controller.signal,
        onProgress: (progress) => sendProgress(window.webContents, progress),
      });
      return { state: result.state, directory: result.directory };
    } finally {
      downloads.delete(event.sender.id);
    }
  });

  ipcMain.handle("album:cancel", (event) => {
    assertWindowSender(event.sender.id);
    downloads.get(event.sender.id)?.abort();
  });
}

async function createWindow(): Promise<void> {
  mainWindow = new BrowserWindow({
    width: 1120,
    height: 780,
    minWidth: 760,
    minHeight: 620,
    backgroundColor: "#101715",
    title: "Khinsider Downloader",
    webPreferences: {
      preload: resolve(__dirname, "preload.cjs"),
      contextIsolation: true,
      nodeIntegration: false,
      sandbox: true,
    },
  });
  mainWindow.webContents.setWindowOpenHandler(() => ({ action: "deny" }));
  mainWindow.webContents.on("will-navigate", (event, url) => {
    if (!url.startsWith("file://")) event.preventDefault();
  });
  mainWindow.on("closed", () => {
    inspections.delete(mainWindow?.webContents.id ?? -1);
    mainWindow = undefined;
  });
  await mainWindow.loadFile(resolve(__dirname, "../gui/index.html"));
}

app.whenReady().then(async () => {
  app.setName("Khinsider Downloader");
  registerIpc();
  await createWindow();
  app.on("activate", () => {
    if (BrowserWindow.getAllWindows().length === 0) void createWindow();
  });
});

app.on("window-all-closed", () => {
  for (const controller of downloads.values()) controller.abort();
  if (process.platform !== "darwin") app.quit();
});

import type { GuiFormatPolicy, GuiInspection, GuiProgress, GuiTrack } from "./gui-types.js";

const albumInput = document.querySelector<HTMLTextAreaElement>("#album-url")!;
const outputInput = document.querySelector<HTMLInputElement>("#output-root")!;
const formatSelect = document.querySelector<HTMLSelectElement>("#format-policy")!;
const skipInput = document.querySelector<HTMLInputElement>("#skip-unavailable")!;
const inspectButton = document.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>("#inspect-button")!;
const downloadButton = document.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>("#download-button")!;
const cancelButton = document.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>("#cancel-button")!;
const browseButton = document.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>("#browse-button")!;
const tableBody = document.querySelector<HTMLTableSectionElement>("#track-rows")!;
const albumTitle = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>("#album-title")!;
const trackCount = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>("#track-count")!;
const statusText = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>("#status-text")!;
const statusDot = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>("#status-dot")!;
const progress = document.querySelector<HTMLProgressElement>("#download-progress")!;
const progressText = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>("#progress-text")!;
const emptyState = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>("#empty-state")!;
const trackTable = document.querySelector<HTMLTableElement>("#track-table")!;
const errorText = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>("#error-text")!;

let inspection: GuiInspection | undefined;
let busy = false;

function setStatus(label: string, tone: "idle" | "working" | "success" | "error" = "idle"): void {
  statusText.textContent = label;
  statusDot.dataset.tone = tone;
}

function selectedFormat(track: GuiTrack): { format?: string; state: string; fallback: boolean } {
  const value = formatSelect.value;
  if (value === "prefer-lossless") {
    const lossless = ["FLAC", "ALAC", "WAV"].find((format) => track.formats.includes(format));
    if (lossless) return { format: lossless, state: "Ready", fallback: false };
    const lossy = track.formats.find((format) => format === "MP3") ?? track.formats[0];
    return lossy
      ? { format: lossy, state: "Ready", fallback: true }
      : { state: "Unavailable", fallback: false };
  }
  const requested = value === "lossless-only" ? ["FLAC", "ALAC", "WAV"].find((format) => track.formats.includes(format)) : value.slice("format:".length);
  if (requested && track.formats.includes(requested)) return { format: requested, state: "Ready", fallback: false };
  return skipInput.checked
    ? { state: "Skipped", fallback: false }
    : { state: "Unavailable", fallback: false };
}

function renderTracks(): void {
  if (!inspection) return;
  const rows = inspection.tracks.map((track) => {
    const selected = selectedFormat(track);
    const row = document.createElement("tr");
    row.innerHTML = `<td class="track-number"></td><td class="track-title"></td><td class="track-formats"></td><td class="track-choice"></td><td class="track-state"></td>`;
    row.querySelector(".track-number")!.textContent = String(track.number).padStart(2, "0");
    row.querySelector(".track-title")!.textContent = track.title;
    row.querySelector(".track-formats")!.textContent = track.formats.join(", ") || "None found";
    row.querySelector(".track-choice")!.textContent = selected.format ?? "-";
    const state = row.querySelector<HTMLElement>(".track-state")!;
    state.textContent = selected.state;
    state.dataset.state = selected.state.toLowerCase();
    if (selected.fallback) state.textContent += " · fallback";
    return row;
  });
  tableBody.replaceChildren(...rows);
  const blocked = inspection.tracks.some((track) => selectedFormat(track).state === "Unavailable");
  downloadButton.disabled = busy || blocked;
  trackCount.textContent = `${inspection.trackCount} tracks`;
  emptyState.hidden = true;
  trackTable.hidden = false;
}

function currentPolicy(): GuiFormatPolicy {
  if (formatSelect.value === "prefer-lossless") return { kind: "prefer-lossless" };
  if (formatSelect.value === "lossless-only") return { kind: "lossless-only", skipUnavailable: skipInput.checked };
  return { kind: "specific", format: formatSelect.value.slice("format:".length), skipUnavailable: skipInput.checked };
}

function updateFormatOptions(): void {
  if (!inspection) return;
  const formats = [...new Set(inspection.tracks.flatMap((track) => track.formats))].sort();
  const previous = formatSelect.value;
  formatSelect.querySelectorAll("option[data-discovered]").forEach((option) => option.remove());
  for (const format of formats) {
    const option = document.createElement("option");
    option.value = `format:${format}`;
    option.textContent = `Specific format: ${format}`;
    option.dataset.discovered = "true";
    formatSelect.append(option);
  }
  if ([...formatSelect.options].some((option) => option.value === previous)) formatSelect.value = previous;
  renderTracks();
}

function setBusy(value: boolean): void {
  busy = value;
  inspectButton.disabled = value;
  browseButton.disabled = value;
  albumInput.disabled = value;
  outputInput.disabled = value;
  formatSelect.disabled = value;
  skipInput.disabled = value;
  cancelButton.disabled = !value;
  if (inspection) renderTracks();
}

inspectButton.addEventListener("click", async () => {
  errorText.textContent = "";
  inspection = undefined;
  downloadButton.disabled = true;
  tableBody.replaceChildren();
  trackTable.hidden = true;
  emptyState.hidden = false;
  setBusy(true);
  setStatus("Opening visible Chromium to inspect pages", "working");
  try {
    inspection = await window.khinsiderDownloader.inspect(albumInput.value.trim());
    albumTitle.textContent = inspection.albumTitle;
    updateFormatOptions();
    setStatus("Preview ready", "success");
  } catch (error) {
    errorText.textContent = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
    setStatus("Inspection failed", "error");
  } finally {
    setBusy(false);
    if (inspection) renderTracks();
  }
});

browseButton.addEventListener("click", async () => {
  const selected = await window.khinsiderDownloader.chooseOutput();
  if (selected) outputInput.value = selected;
});

formatSelect.addEventListener("change", () => {
  skipInput.disabled = busy || formatSelect.value === "prefer-lossless";
  renderTracks();
});
skipInput.addEventListener("change", renderTracks);

downloadButton.addEventListener("click", async () => {
  if (!inspection) return;
  errorText.textContent = "";
  progress.value = 0;
  progressText.textContent = "Preparing album";
  setBusy(true);
  setStatus("Downloading", "working");
  try {
    const result = await window.khinsiderDownloader.download({ policy: currentPolicy(), outputRoot: outputInput.value });
    progress.value = inspection.trackCount;
    progress.max = inspection.trackCount;
    progressText.textContent = `${result.state} · ${result.directory}`;
    setStatus(result.state === "complete" ? "Download complete" : result.state, result.state === "complete" ? "success" : "error");
  } catch (error) {
    errorText.textContent = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
    setStatus("Download failed", "error");
  } finally {
    setBusy(false);
  }
});

cancelButton.addEventListener("click", async () => {
  cancelButton.disabled = true;
  await window.khinsiderDownloader.cancel();
  setStatus("Canceling active track…", "working");
});

window.khinsiderDownloader.onProgress((event: GuiProgress) => {
  progress.max = event.totalTracks;
  progress.value = event.completedTracks;
  progressText.textContent = event.stage === "track-start"
    ? `Downloading ${String(event.number).padStart(2, "0")} · ${event.title}`
    : event.stage === "track-complete"
      ? `Completed ${event.completedTracks} of ${event.totalTracks} tracks`
      : event.stage === "track-failed"
        ? `Failed ${String(event.number).padStart(2, "0")} · ${event.title}`
        : "Canceled";
});

void window.khinsiderDownloader.defaultOutputRoot().then((value) => { outputInput.value = value; });

@import url("https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Mono:wght@400;500&family=Manrope:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap");

:root {
  color-scheme: dark;
  --ink: #e8efec;
  --muted: #91a09b;
  --dim: #60716b;
  --line: #2c3a35;
  --panel: #17211d;
  --panel-raised: #1d2a25;
  --ground: #101715;
  --mint: #b3f06c;
  --mint-dark: #83bd42;
  --coral: #f28568;
  --blue: #80bac5;
  font-family: "Manrope", "Noto Sans", sans-serif;
  color: var(--ink);
  background: var(--ground);
  font-synthesis: none;
  text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
}

* { box-sizing: border-box; }
body {
  margin: 0;
  min-width: 720px;
  min-height: 100vh;
  background:
    linear-gradient(115deg, rgba(111, 148, 126, .07), transparent 44%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 95% 100%, rgba(86, 135, 143, .08), transparent 36%),
    var(--ground);
}
button, input, textarea, select { font: inherit; }

button:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: .42; }

.brand-name { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 800; }

```
import { cp, mkdir, rm } from "node:fs/promises";
import { dirname, resolve } from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
import { build } from "esbuild";

const root = resolve(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "..");
const output = resolve(root, "dist");
await rm(output, { recursive: true, force: true });
await mkdir(resolve(output, "electron"), { recursive: true });
await mkdir(resolve(output, "gui"), { recursive: true });

await Promise.all([
  build({
    entryPoints: [resolve(root, "src/electron/main.ts")],
    outfile: resolve(output, "electron/main.cjs"),
    bundle: true,
    platform: "node",
    format: "cjs",
    external: ["electron", "playwright", "parse5"],
  }),
  build({
    entryPoints: [resolve(root, "src/electron/preload.ts")],
    outfile: resolve(output, "electron/preload.cjs"),
    bundle: true,
    platform: "node",
    format: "cjs",
    external: ["electron"],
  }),
  build({
    entryPoints: [resolve(root, "src/renderer.ts")],
    outfile: resolve(output, "gui/renderer.js"),
    bundle: true,
    platform: "browser",
    format: "iife",
  }),
]);

await Promise.all([
  cp(resolve(root, "gui/index.html"), resolve(output, "gui/index.html")),
  cp(resolve(root, "gui/styles.css"), resolve(output, "gui/styles.css")),
]);
console.log("Built Electron main/preload and local renderer into dist/.");
```

````
# Khinsider Downloader

Khinsider Downloader is a Linux-first KHInsider album downloader. The current slice
implements public single-album discovery, format preview and policy, sequential
streaming, and manifest-backed reruns. Multi-album queues, artwork, the GUI,
optional account features, and packaging are not implemented yet.

## Discovery check

Requirements: Node.js 20 or newer, npm, and a graphical desktop session.

```sh
npm install
npx playwright install chromium
npm run inspect -- 'https://downloads.khinsider.com/game-soundtracks/album/unreal-ii-the-awakening-original-soundtrack'
```

The command opens a fresh visible Chromium context without a stored browser
profile, visits the album and track pages sequentially, and prints every
track's discovered format selection. It does not sign in or download audio.
Visible mode is currently needed: plain Node fetch and headless Chromium
received HTTP 403 during feasibility checks, while a fresh visible Chromium
context succeeded. No attempt is made to imitate a browser or evade a challenge.
If access is denied or a challenge appears, stop and review the site's permitted
access methods.

## Download One Album

The CLI previews the selected formats before starting any transfer. The default
format policy prefers lossless, falling back to MP3 when needed. The default
destination is `~/Music/Khinsider Downloader`.

```sh
npm run download -- 'https://downloads.khinsider.com/game-soundtracks/album/unreal-ii-the-awakening-original-soundtrack'
```

Use `--format lossless-only` to block when a track has no lossless source. Add
`--skip-unavailable` to explicitly skip those tracks and mark the album
incomplete. A specific format such as `--format MP3` never silently substitutes
another format. Use `--output /path/to/music` for another destination.

Files are streamed through temporary `.part` files, validated, and moved into
place without overwriting. A per-album manifest records completion so verified
files can be skipped on rerun. Transfers are covered by local mocked tests; an
authorized live audio download has not yet been run.

## Desktop GUI

Requirements: Node.js 20 or newer, npm, and a graphical Linux session.

```sh
npm install
npx playwright install chromium
npm run gui
```

Paste one album URL and choose **Inspect album**. A separate visible Chromium
window opens during discovery. Review the per-track format preview, choose the
destination and format policy, then select **Download**. The default destination
is `~/Music/Khinsider Downloader`. **Cancel active download** stops the current transfer
and prevents later tracks from starting.

The GUI uses a context-isolated, sandboxed renderer with a narrow preload API.
It currently supports one album per run; multi-album queues and packaging are
not available yet.

## Development

```sh
npm test
npm run build
npm audit
```
````

import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { parseAlbumPage, parseTrackPage, validateAlbumUrl } from "../src/khinsider.js";

const albumUrl = new URL("https://downloads.khinsider.com/game-soundtracks/album/fixture-album");
const albumHtml = readFileSync(fileURLToPath(new URL("./fixtures/album.html", import.meta.url)), "utf8");
const trackHtml = readFileSync(fileURLToPath(new URL("./fixtures/track.html", import.meta.url)), "utf8");

describe("KHInsider page parsing", () => {
  it("keeps ordered track-page links and ignores bulk and recommendation links", () => {
    const result = parseAlbumPage(albumHtml, albumUrl);
    expect(result.title).toBe("Fixture Album");
    expect(result.advertisedTrackCount).toBe(2);
    expect(result.tracks.map(({ number, title }) => [number, title])).toEqual([
      [1, "Opening"],
      [2, "Finale"],

    expect(result.tracks.every(({ pageUrl }) => pageUrl.pathname.startsWith(`${albumUrl.pathname}/`))).toBe(true);

    expect(result).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(result[0].format).toBe("MP3");
    expect(result[0].url.hostname).toBe("media.example.test");

  it("rejects unrelated or insecure album URLs", () => {
    expect(() => validateAlbumUrl("http://downloads.khinsider.com/game-soundtracks/album/test")).toThrow();
    expect(() => validateAlbumUrl("https://example.com/game-soundtracks/album/test")).toThrow();

});

```
import { chromium } from "playwright";
import { parse } from "parse5";

const SITE_HOST = "downloads.khinsider.com";
const AUDIO_EXTENSIONS = new Set(["mp3", "flac", "ogg", "opus", "m4a", "aac", "wav", "wma", "alac"]);

export type TrackLink = {
  discNumber?: number;
  number: number;
  title: string;
  pageUrl: URL;
};

export type AudioLink = {
  format: string;
  url: URL;
};

export type AlbumPage = {
  title: string;
  advertisedTrackCount?: number;
  tracks: TrackLink[];
};

export type DiscoveredTrack = TrackLink & {
  audioLinks: AudioLink[];
};

function* walk(node: any): Generator<any> {
  yield node;
  for (const child of node.childNodes ?? []) yield* walk(child);
}

function textContent(node: any): string {
  if (node.nodeName === "#text") return node.value;
  return (node.childNodes ?? []).map(textContent).join(" ").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
}

function href(node: any, baseUrl: URL): URL | undefined {
  const value = node.attrs?.find((attribute: any) => attribute.name === "href")?.value;
  if (!value) return undefined;
  try {
    const url = new URL(value, baseUrl);
    if (url.protocol !== "https:" || url.username || url.password) return undefined;
    return url;
  } catch {
    return undefined;
  }
}

function numberedTrack(
  row: any,
  albumUrl: URL,
  columns: { disc: number; track: number },
): TrackLink | undefined {
  const cells = (row.childNodes ?? []).filter((node: any) => node.tagName === "td" || node.tagName === "th");
  const cellNumber = (index: number): number | undefined => {
    if (index < 0 || index >= cells.length) return undefined;
    const value = textContent(cells[index]);
    return /^\s*\d+\.?\s*$/.test(value) ? Number.parseInt(value, 10) : undefined;
  };
  const discNumber = cellNumber(columns.disc);
  const number = cellNumber(columns.track);
  if (number === undefined) return undefined;

  const anchors = [...walk(row)].filter((node) => node.tagName === "a");
  for (const anchor of anchors) {
    const pageUrl = href(anchor, albumUrl);
    if (
      !pageUrl ||
      pageUrl.hostname.toLowerCase() !== SITE_HOST ||
      !pageUrl.pathname.startsWith(`${albumUrl.pathname.replace(/\/$/, "")}/`)
    ) continue;

    const title = textContent(anchor);
    if (!title) continue;
    return { ...(discNumber === undefined ? {} : { discNumber }), number, title, pageUrl };
  }
  return undefined;
}

export function validateAlbumUrl(input: string): URL {
  const url = new URL(input);
  if (
    url.protocol !== "https:" ||
    url.hostname.toLowerCase() !== SITE_HOST ||
    url.username ||
    url.password ||
    !url.pathname.startsWith("/game-soundtracks/album/")
  ) {
    throw new Error(`Expected an HTTPS KHInsider album URL on ${SITE_HOST}`);
  }
  url.hash = "";
  return url;
}

export function parseAlbumPage(html: string, albumUrl: URL): AlbumPage {
  const document = parse(html);
  const text = textContent(document);
  const advertisedMatch = text.match(/Number of Files:\s*(\d+)/i);
  const pageTitle = [...walk(document)].find((node) => node.tagName === "title");
  const titleMatch = pageTitle && textContent(pageTitle).match(
    /^(.*?)\s+(?:MP3|FLAC|OGG|OPUS|M4A|AAC|WAV|WMA|ALAC)\s+-\s+Download Soundtracks/i,
  );
  const heading = [...walk(document)].find((node) => node.tagName === "h2" || node.tagName === "h1");
  const rows = [...walk(document)].filter((node) => node.tagName === "tr");
  const header = rows.find((row) => [...walk(row)].some((node) => node.tagName === "th"));
  const headers = header
    ? (header.childNodes ?? []).filter((node: any) => node.tagName === "th" || node.tagName === "td").map(textContent)
    : [];
  const discColumn = headers.findIndex((label: string) => /^\s*(?:cd|disc(?:\s*(?:number|#))?)\s*$/i.test(label));
  const trackColumn = headers.findIndex((label: string) => /^\s*(?:#|track(?:\s*(?:number|#))?)\s*$/i.test(label));
  const tracks = [...walk(document)]
    .filter((node) => node.tagName === "tr")
    .map((row) => {
      const cells = (row.childNodes ?? []).filter((node: any) => node.tagName === "td" || node.tagName === "th");
      const numericIndices = cells
        .map((cell: any, index: number) => /^\s*\d+\.?\s*$/.test(textContent(cell)) ? index : -1)
        .filter((index: number) => index >= 0);
      const disc = discColumn >= 0 ? discColumn : numericIndices.length > 1 ? numericIndices[0] : -1;
      const track = trackColumn >= 0
        ? trackColumn
        : numericIndices.find((index: number) => index !== disc) ?? numericIndices[0] ?? -1;
      return numberedTrack(row, albumUrl, { disc, track });
    })
    .filter((track): track is TrackLink => track !== undefined);

  return {
    title: titleMatch?.[1] ?? (heading ? textContent(heading) : albumUrl.pathname.split("/").filter(Boolean).at(-1) ?? "Album"),
    advertisedTrackCount: advertisedMatch ? Number(advertisedMatch[1]) : undefined,
    tracks,
  };
}

export function parseTrackPage(html: string, trackUrl: URL): AudioLink[] {
  const document = parse(html);
  const links: AudioLink[] = [];
  const seen = new Set<string>();

  for (const anchor of [...walk(document)].filter((node) => node.tagName === "a")) {
    const label = textContent(anchor);
    if (!/click here to download as/i.test(label)) continue;
    const url = href(anchor, trackUrl);
    if (!url || seen.has(url.href)) continue;
    const extension = url.pathname.split(".").at(-1)?.toLowerCase();
    const format = extension && AUDIO_EXTENSIONS.has(extension) ? extension.toUpperCase() : undefined;
    if (!format) continue;
    seen.add(url.href);
    links.push({ format, url });
  }

  return links;
}

export async function inspectAlbum(input: string): Promise<{ album: AlbumPage; tracks: DiscoveredTrack[] }> {
  const albumUrl = validateAlbumUrl(input);
  const browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: false });
  const context = await browser.newContext({ serviceWorkers: "block" });

  try {
    const page = await context.newPage();
    const albumResponse = await page.goto(albumUrl.href, { waitUntil: "domcontentloaded", timeout: 30_000 });
    if (!albumResponse || !albumResponse.ok()) {
      throw new Error(`Album page request failed with HTTP ${albumResponse?.status() ?? "no response"}`);
    }

    const album = parseAlbumPage(await albumResponse.text(), albumUrl);
    if (album.advertisedTrackCount !== undefined && album.tracks.length !== album.advertisedTrackCount) {
      throw new Error(`Album advertises ${album.advertisedTrackCount} tracks but ${album.tracks.length} track links were found`);
    }
    if (album.tracks.length === 0) throw new Error("No numbered track-page links were found");

    const tracks: DiscoveredTrack[] = [];
    for (const [index, track] of album.tracks.entries()) {
      if (index > 0) await page.waitForTimeout(1_000);
      const trackResponse = await page.goto(track.pageUrl.href, { waitUntil: "domcontentloaded", timeout: 30_000 });
      if (!trackResponse || !trackResponse.ok()) {
        throw new Error(`Track ${track.number} page request failed with HTTP ${trackResponse?.status() ?? "no response"}`);
      }
      tracks.push({ ...track, audioLinks: parseTrackPage(await trackResponse.text(), track.pageUrl) });
    }

    return { album, tracks };
  } finally {
    await context.close();
    await browser.close();
  }
}
```

import { createHash, randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { lstat, mkdir, readFile, rename, rm, stat, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import { homedir } from "node:os";
import { dirname, join } from "node:path";

export const MANIFEST_FILENAME = ".download-manifest.json";

export type ManifestTrack = {
  discNumber?: number;
  number: number;
  title: string;
  filename: string;
  format: string;
  state: "queued" | "downloading" | "complete" | "skipped" | "failed" | "canceled";
  bytes?: number;
  error?: string;
};

export type AlbumManifest = {
  schemaVersion: 1;
  sourceAlbum: string;
  title: string;
  state: "downloading" | "complete" | "incomplete" | "failed" | "canceled";
  updatedAt: string;
  tracks: ManifestTrack[];
};

export function defaultOutputRoot(): string {
  return join(homedir(), "Music", "Khinsider Downloader");
}

export function safeFileComponent(value: string): string {
  const normalized = value
    .normalize("NFC")
    .replace(/[<>:"/\\|?*\u0000-\u001f]/g, "-")
    .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
    .replace(/[. ]+$/g, "")
    .trim();
  return (normalized || "Untitled").slice(0, 120);
}

export function trackFilename(number: number, total: number, title: string, format: string): string {
  const width = Math.max(2, String(total).length);
  const extension = format.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, "");
  if (!extension) throw new Error(`Invalid audio format: ${format}`);
  return `${String(number).padStart(width, "0")} - ${safeFileComponent(title)}.${extension}`;
}

export function trackRelativePath(
  track: Pick<ManifestTrack, "discNumber" | "number" | "title">,
  totalOnDisc: number,
  format: string,
  discLabel: "CD" | "Disc",
  useDiscFolders: boolean,
): string {
  const filename = trackFilename(track.number, totalOnDisc, track.title, format);
  if (!useDiscFolders) return filename;
  if (!Number.isInteger(track.discNumber) || (track.discNumber ?? 0) < 1) {
    throw new Error(`Missing valid disc number for track ${track.number}: ${track.title}`);
  }
  return join(`${discLabel}${track.discNumber}`, filename);
}

function sourceIdentity(sourceAlbum: string): string {
  return createHash("sha256").update(new URL(sourceAlbum).pathname).digest("hex").slice(0, 8);
}

async function readSourceFromManifest(directory: string): Promise<string | undefined> {
  try {
    const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(await readFile(join(directory, MANIFEST_FILENAME), "utf8"));
    if (typeof parsed === "object" && parsed !== null && "sourceAlbum" in parsed && typeof parsed.sourceAlbum === "string") {
      return parsed.sourceAlbum;
    }
    return undefined;
  } catch {
    return undefined;
  }
}

export async function prepareAlbumDirectory(outputRoot: string, title: string, sourceAlbum: string): Promise<string> {
  await mkdir(outputRoot, { recursive: true });
  if (!(await stat(outputRoot)).isDirectory()) throw new Error(`Output root is not a directory: ${outputRoot}`);

  const baseDirectory = join(outputRoot, safeFileComponent(title));
  if (!(await exists(baseDirectory))) {
    await mkdir(baseDirectory);
    return baseDirectory;
  }
  if (await readSourceFromManifest(baseDirectory) === sourceAlbum) return baseDirectory;

  const identifiedDirectory = `${baseDirectory} [${sourceIdentity(sourceAlbum)}]`;
  if (!(await exists(identifiedDirectory))) {
    await mkdir(identifiedDirectory);
    return identifiedDirectory;
  }
  if (await readSourceFromManifest(identifiedDirectory) === sourceAlbum) return identifiedDirectory;
  throw new Error(`Album output folder is occupied by unrelated or unverifiable files: ${identifiedDirectory}`);
}

export async function readManifest(directory: string): Promise<AlbumManifest | undefined> {
  let raw: string;
  try {
    raw = await readFile(join(directory, MANIFEST_FILENAME), "utf8");
  } catch (error) {
    if ((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code === "ENOENT") return undefined;
    throw error;
  }

  const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(raw);
  if (
    typeof parsed !== "object" || parsed === null ||
    !("schemaVersion" in parsed) || parsed.schemaVersion !== 1 ||
    !("sourceAlbum" in parsed) || typeof parsed.sourceAlbum !== "string" ||
    !("title" in parsed) || typeof parsed.title !== "string" ||
    !("state" in parsed) || typeof parsed.state !== "string" ||
    !("tracks" in parsed) || !Array.isArray(parsed.tracks)
  ) {
    throw new Error(`Invalid download manifest: ${join(directory, MANIFEST_FILENAME)}`);
  }
  return parsed as AlbumManifest;
}

async function exists(path: string): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    await lstat(path);
    return true;
  } catch (error) {
    if ((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code === "ENOENT") return false;
    throw error;
  }
}

export async function writeManifest(directory: string, manifest: AlbumManifest): Promise<void> {
  const destination = join(directory, MANIFEST_FILENAME);
  const temporary = join(dirname(destination), `${MANIFEST_FILENAME}.${randomUUID()}.tmp`);
  try {
    await writeFile(temporary, `${JSON.stringify(manifest, null, 2)}\n`, { flag: "wx" });
    await rename(temporary, destination);
  } finally {
    await rm(temporary, { force: true });
  }
}

import { lstat, rm, stat } from "node:fs/promises";
import { join } from "node:path";
import { planFormats, type FormatPolicy } from "./formats.js";
import type { AlbumPage, DiscoveredTrack } from "./khinsider.js";
import {
  prepareAlbumDirectory,
  readManifest,
  trackRelativePath,
  writeManifest,
  type AlbumManifest,
  type ManifestTrack,
} from "./output.js";
import { MediaResponseError, streamMediaToFile, type TransferOptions, type TransferResult } from "./transfer.js";

export type DownloadOptions = {
  sourceAlbum: string;
  album: AlbumPage;
  tracks: DiscoveredTrack[];
  outputRoot: string;
  policy: FormatPolicy;
  discLabel?: "CD" | "Disc";
  signal?: AbortSignal;
  onProgress?: (progress: DownloadProgress) => void;
  fetchImpl?: TransferOptions["fetchImpl"];
  resolveAddresses?: TransferOptions["resolveAddresses"];
};

export type DownloadProgress = {
  stage: "track-start" | "track-complete" | "track-failed" | "canceled";
  number: number;
  title: string;
  completedTracks: number;
  totalTracks: number;
  bytesReceived?: number;
};

export type DownloadResult = {
  directory: string;
  state: AlbumManifest["state"];
  tracks: ManifestTrack[];
};

export class FormatPlanBlockedError extends Error {
  constructor(readonly tracks: string[]) {
    super(`Download blocked; resolve unavailable formats first: ${tracks.join(", ")}`);
    this.name = "FormatPlanBlockedError";
  }
}

async function fileExists(path: string): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    await lstat(path);
    return true;
  } catch (error) {
    if ((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code === "ENOENT") return false;
    throw error;
  }
}

async function isVerifiedComplete(directory: string, entry: ManifestTrack | undefined): Promise<boolean> {
  if (!entry || entry.state !== "complete" || !entry.bytes || !entry.filename) return false;
  try {
    const file = await stat(join(directory, entry.filename));
    return file.isFile() && file.size === entry.bytes;
  } catch (error) {
    if ((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code === "ENOENT") return false;
    throw error;
  }
}

function createManifestTrack(
  number: number,
  title: string,
  filename: string,
  format: string,
  state: ManifestTrack["state"],
): ManifestTrack {
  return { number, title, filename, format, state };
}

export async function downloadAlbum(options: DownloadOptions): Promise<DownloadResult> {
  const plan = planFormats(options.tracks, options.policy);
  const blockedTracks = plan.tracks
    .filter((selection) => selection.state === "unavailable")
    .map(({ track, reason }) => `${track.number}. ${track.title}: ${reason}`);
  if (blockedTracks.length > 0) throw new FormatPlanBlockedError(blockedTracks);

  const discNumbers = new Set(options.tracks.flatMap((track) => track.discNumber ? [track.discNumber] : []));
  const useDiscFolders = discNumbers.size > 1;
  if (useDiscFolders && options.tracks.some((track) => track.discNumber === undefined)) {
    throw new Error("Multi-disc album contains tracks without a disc number");
  }
  const maxTrackNumberByDisc = new Map<number, number>();
  for (const track of options.tracks) {
    const discNumber = track.discNumber ?? 1;
    maxTrackNumberByDisc.set(discNumber, Math.max(maxTrackNumberByDisc.get(discNumber) ?? 0, track.number));
  }

  const directory = await prepareAlbumDirectory(options.outputRoot, options.album.title, options.sourceAlbum);
  const previous = await readManifest(directory);
  if (previous && previous.sourceAlbum !== options.sourceAlbum) {
    throw new Error(`Manifest source does not match album URL: ${directory}`);
  }

  const manifestTracks: ManifestTrack[] = [];
  for (const selection of plan.tracks) {
    const { track, selected, state } = selection;
    if (!selected || state === "skipped") {
      manifestTracks.push(createManifestTrack(track.number, track.title, "", "", "skipped"));
      continue;
    }

    const filename = trackRelativePath(
      track,
      maxTrackNumberByDisc.get(track.discNumber ?? 1) ?? plan.tracks.length,
      selected.format,
      options.discLabel ?? "CD",
      useDiscFolders,
    );
    const current = previous?.tracks.find((entry) => entry.filename === filename && entry.format === selected.format);
    const target = join(directory, filename);
    const partial = `${target}.part`;
    const targetExists = await fileExists(target);
    if (targetExists && !(await isVerifiedComplete(directory, current))) {
      throw new Error(`Existing file is not verified by the manifest: ${target}`);
    }
    if (await fileExists(partial)) {
      if (current?.state === "downloading" || current?.state === "failed") await rm(partial);
      else throw new Error(`Unverified partial file already exists: ${partial}`);
    }
    manifestTracks.push({
      ...createManifestTrack(track.number, track.title, filename, selected.format, targetExists ? "complete" : "queued"),
      ...(track.discNumber === undefined ? {} : { discNumber: track.discNumber }),
      ...(targetExists ? { bytes: current?.bytes } : {}),
    });
  }

  const manifest: AlbumManifest = {
    schemaVersion: 1,
    sourceAlbum: options.sourceAlbum,
    title: options.album.title,
    state: "downloading",
    updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    tracks: manifestTracks,
  };
  await writeManifest(directory, manifest);

  let completedTracks = manifest.tracks.filter((track) => track.state === "complete" || track.state === "skipped").length;
  let canceled = false;
  for (const [index, selection] of plan.tracks.entries()) {
    const entry = manifest.tracks[index];
    if (entry.state === "complete" || entry.state === "skipped") continue;
    const audio = selection.selected;
    if (!audio) continue;

    if (options.signal?.aborted) {
      entry.state = "canceled";
      for (const queued of manifest.tracks.slice(index + 1)) {
        if (queued.state === "queued") queued.state = "canceled";
      }
      canceled = true;
      options.onProgress?.({ stage: "canceled", number: entry.number, title: entry.title, completedTracks, totalTracks: manifest.tracks.length });
      break;
    }

    entry.state = "downloading";
    options.onProgress?.({ stage: "track-start", number: entry.number, title: entry.title, completedTracks, totalTracks: manifest.tracks.length });
    manifest.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    await writeManifest(directory, manifest);
    try {
      const transferOptions: TransferOptions = {
        allowedHosts: new Set([audio.url.hostname.toLowerCase()]),
        expectedFormat: audio.format,
        ...(options.signal ? { signal: options.signal } : {}),
        ...(options.fetchImpl ? { fetchImpl: options.fetchImpl } : {}),
        ...(options.resolveAddresses ? { resolveAddresses: options.resolveAddresses } : {}),
      };
      const result: TransferResult = await streamMediaToFile(audio.url, join(directory, entry.filename), transferOptions);
      entry.state = "complete";
      entry.bytes = result.bytes;
      delete entry.error;
      completedTracks += 1;
      options.onProgress?.({ stage: "track-complete", number: entry.number, title: entry.title, completedTracks, totalTracks: manifest.tracks.length, bytesReceived: result.bytes });
    } catch (error) {
      if (options.signal?.aborted) {
        entry.state = "canceled";
        for (const queued of manifest.tracks.slice(index + 1)) {
          if (queued.state === "queued") queued.state = "canceled";
        }
        canceled = true;
        options.onProgress?.({ stage: "canceled", number: entry.number, title: entry.title, completedTracks, totalTracks: manifest.tracks.length });
        manifest.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
        await writeManifest(directory, manifest);
        break;
      }
      entry.state = "failed";
      entry.error = error instanceof Error ? error.message.slice(0, 500) : String(error).slice(0, 500);
      options.onProgress?.({ stage: "track-failed", number: entry.number, title: entry.title, completedTracks, totalTracks: manifest.tracks.length });
      manifest.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
      await writeManifest(directory, manifest);
      if (error instanceof MediaResponseError && [403, 429].includes(error.status)) break;
      continue;
    }
    manifest.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    await writeManifest(directory, manifest);
  }

  const hasFailures = manifest.tracks.some((track) => track.state === "failed");
  const hasSkips = manifest.tracks.some((track) => track.state === "skipped");
  manifest.state = canceled ? "canceled" : hasFailures ? "failed" : hasSkips ? "incomplete" : "complete";
  manifest.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
  await writeManifest(directory, manifest);
  return { directory, state: manifest.state, tracks: manifest.tracks };
}

    expect(trackRelativePath({ discNumber: 2, number: 1, title: "Serenity" }, 24, "MP3", "Disc", true)).toBe("Disc2/01 - Serenity.mp3");

    const firstSource = "https://downloads.khinsider.com/game-soundtracks/album/first";

    const firstDirectory = await prepareAlbumDirectory(root, "Same: Title", firstSource);
    await writeManifest(firstDirectory, {
      schemaVersion: 1,
      sourceAlbum: firstSource,
      title: "Same: Title",
      state: "downloading",
      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      tracks: [],
    });

    expect(await readFile(join(firstDirectory, ".download-manifest.json"), "utf8")).toContain(firstSource);
    expect(await prepareAlbumDirectory(root, "Same: Title", firstSource)).toBe(firstDirectory);
    const secondDirectory = await prepareAlbumDirectory(root, "Same: Title", secondSource);
    expect(secondDirectory).not.toBe(firstDirectory);
    expect(secondDirectory).toContain("Same- Title [");
  });
});

import { mkdtemp, readFile, readdir, rm } from "node:fs/promises";
import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
import { join } from "node:path";
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { downloadAlbum, FormatPlanBlockedError } from "../src/downloader.js";
import type { AlbumPage, DiscoveredTrack } from "../src/khinsider.js";

const sourceAlbum = "https://downloads.khinsider.com/game-soundtracks/album/fixture-album";
const audioHost = "lambda.vgmtreasurechest.com";
const resolveAddresses = async () => [{ address: "93.184.216.34", family: 4 }];
const temporaryDirectories: string[] = [];

const album: AlbumPage = {
  title: "Fixture Album",
  advertisedTrackCount: 2,
  tracks: [],
};

function tracks(formats: string[][] = [["MP3"], ["MP3"]]): DiscoveredTrack[] {
  return formats.map((available, index) => ({
    number: index + 1,
    title: index === 0 ? "Opening" : "Finale",
    pageUrl: new URL(`${sourceAlbum}/${String(index + 1).padStart(2, "0")}.mp3`),
    audioLinks: available.map((format) => ({
      format,
      url: new URL(`https://${audioHost}/${index + 1}.${format.toLowerCase()}`),
    })),
  }));
}

async function temporaryDirectory(): Promise<string> {
  const directory = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), "khinsider-downloader-album-test-"));
  temporaryDirectories.push(directory);
  return directory;
}

afterEach(async () => {
  await Promise.all(temporaryDirectories.splice(0).map((directory) => rm(directory, { recursive: true, force: true })));
});

describe("single-album download", () => {
  it("streams selected tracks and skips size-verified files on rerun", async () => {
    const outputRoot = await temporaryDirectory();
    const fetchImpl = vi.fn(async () => new Response(new Uint8Array([1, 2, 3]), {
      status: 200,
      headers: { "content-type": "audio/mpeg", "content-length": "3" },
    }));
    const options = {
      sourceAlbum,
      album,
      tracks: tracks(),
      outputRoot,
      policy: { kind: "prefer-lossless" as const },
      fetchImpl,
      resolveAddresses,
    };

    const first = await downloadAlbum(options);
    expect(first.state).toBe("complete");
    expect(first.tracks.map(({ state }) => state)).toEqual(["complete", "complete"]);
    expect(fetchImpl).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
    expect(await readdir(first.directory)).toEqual([
      ".download-manifest.json",
      "01 - Opening.mp3",
      "02 - Finale.mp3",
    ]);

    const manifest = JSON.parse(await readFile(join(first.directory, ".download-manifest.json"), "utf8"));
    expect(manifest.state).toBe("complete");
    expect(manifest.tracks.map((track: { bytes: number }) => track.bytes)).toEqual([3, 3]);

    const rerunFetch = vi.fn();
    const second = await downloadAlbum({ ...options, fetchImpl: rerunFetch });
    expect(second.directory).toBe(first.directory);
    expect(second.state).toBe("complete");
    expect(rerunFetch).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("blocks unavailable lossless tracks before creating output or transferring", async () => {
    const outputRoot = join(await temporaryDirectory(), "not-created");
    const fetchImpl = vi.fn();
    await expect(downloadAlbum({
      sourceAlbum,
      album,
      tracks: tracks([["FLAC"], ["MP3"]]),
      outputRoot,
      policy: { kind: "lossless-only" },
      fetchImpl,
      resolveAddresses,
    })).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(FormatPlanBlockedError);
    expect(fetchImpl).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    await expect(readdir(outputRoot)).rejects.toThrow();
  });

  it("stops the album on site-wide 403 and leaves later tracks queued", async () => {
    const outputRoot = await temporaryDirectory();
    const fetchImpl = vi.fn(async () => new Response("denied", { status: 403 }));
    const result = await downloadAlbum({
      sourceAlbum,
      album,
      tracks: tracks(),
      outputRoot,
      policy: { kind: "prefer-lossless" },
      fetchImpl,
      resolveAddresses,
    });
    expect(fetchImpl).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(result.state).toBe("failed");
    expect(result.tracks.map(({ state }) => state)).toEqual(["failed", "queued"]);
  });

  it("cancels the active stream, removes its partial file, and prevents later tracks", async () => {
    const outputRoot = await temporaryDirectory();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    let signalStreamStarted!: () => void;
    const streamStarted = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { signalStreamStarted = resolve; });
    const fetchImpl = vi.fn(async (_input: URL | RequestInfo, init?: RequestInit) => new Response(new ReadableStream({
      start(controllerStream) {
        controllerStream.enqueue(new Uint8Array([1, 2, 3]));
        init?.signal?.addEventListener("abort", () => controllerStream.error(new Error("aborted")), { once: true });
        signalStreamStarted();
      },
    }), { status: 200, headers: { "content-type": "audio/mpeg" } }));

    const run = downloadAlbum({
      sourceAlbum,
      album,
      tracks: tracks(),
      outputRoot,
      policy: { kind: "prefer-lossless" },
      signal: controller.signal,
      fetchImpl,
      resolveAddresses,
    });
    await streamStarted;
    controller.abort();
    const result = await run;
    expect(result.state).toBe("canceled");
    expect(result.tracks.map(({ state }) => state)).toEqual(["canceled", "canceled"]);
    expect(fetchImpl).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect((await readdir(result.directory)).some((filename) => filename.endsWith(".part"))).toBe(false);
  });

  it("stores tracks in per-disc folders with track numbers reset per disc", async () => {
    const outputRoot = await temporaryDirectory();
    const multiDiscTracks: DiscoveredTrack[] = [
      { discNumber: 1, number: 1, title: "Opening", pageUrl: new URL(`${sourceAlbum}/cd1/01.mp3`), audioLinks: [{ format: "MP3", url: new URL(`https://${audioHost}/cd1-01.mp3`) }] },
      { discNumber: 1, number: 2, title: "Menu", pageUrl: new URL(`${sourceAlbum}/cd1/02.mp3`), audioLinks: [{ format: "MP3", url: new URL(`https://${audioHost}/cd1-02.mp3`) }] },
      { discNumber: 2, number: 1, title: "Serenity", pageUrl: new URL(`${sourceAlbum}/cd2/01.mp3`), audioLinks: [{ format: "MP3", url: new URL(`https://${audioHost}/cd2-01.mp3`) }] },
      { discNumber: 2, number: 2, title: "Finale", pageUrl: new URL(`${sourceAlbum}/cd2/02.mp3`), audioLinks: [{ format: "MP3", url: new URL(`https://${audioHost}/cd2-02.mp3`) }] },
    ];
    const fetchImpl = async () => new Response(new Uint8Array([1, 2, 3]), {
      status: 200,
      headers: { "content-type": "audio/mpeg", "content-length": "3" },
    });
    const result = await downloadAlbum({
      sourceAlbum,
      album: { ...album, title: "Multi Disc Fixture", tracks: [] },
      tracks: multiDiscTracks,
      outputRoot,
      policy: { kind: "prefer-lossless" },
      discLabel: "Disc",
      fetchImpl,
      resolveAddresses,
    });
    expect(result.state).toBe("complete");
    expect(await readdir(join(result.directory, "Disc1"))).toEqual(["01 - Opening.mp3", "02 - Menu.mp3"]);
    expect(await readdir(join(result.directory, "Disc2"))).toEqual(["01 - Serenity.mp3", "02 - Finale.mp3"]);
    expect(result.tracks.map(({ discNumber, filename }) => [discNumber, filename])).toEqual([
      [1, "Disc1/01 - Opening.mp3"],
      [1, "Disc1/02 - Menu.mp3"],
      [2, "Disc2/01 - Serenity.mp3"],
      [2, "Disc2/02 - Finale.mp3"],
    ]);
  });
});
